kcc_query_text_example: OBC medium paddy grower with 8.0 acres canal command in Yellapur taluk, Uttara Kannada; acquired land title via registered statutory succession following father's demise in November 2021 (Death Cert DC/UK/2021/8841 and Bhoomi mutation Form 16 MR No. 2022-T209 verified); seeking 40% capital subsidy on power tiller and walk-behind paddy transplanter under SMAM; verifying PM-KISAN succession status.

water_and_irrigation.grid_connection_evidence: Kali river basin canal distributary gravity flow with farm intermediate storage sump

statutory_flags.tenure_documentation: Title acquired via registered inheritance succession following demise of father in Nov 2021; Death Cert No. DC/UK/2021/8841, Legal Heir Certificate LHC/UK/2022/412, and Bhoomi mutation Form 16 MR No. 2022-T209 (18.03.2022) verified under PM-KISAN Revised Operational Guidelines §§5.2–5.3.3(i)

statutory_succession_details.statutory_distinction: Ownership transferred through inheritance resulting from demise of parent (§5.2 and §5.3.3(i)); strictly distinct from post-cutoff sale, partition, or gift deeds which are excluded under §5.3.3(ii).
statutory_succession_details.engine_input_interpretation: land_ownership_cutoff_pre_feb_2019 = True correctly represents statutory compliance under the §§5.2–5.3.3(i) inheritance exception, passing the PMKISAN_CUTOFF_DATE_VERIFIED rule.

attribute_provenance.empirical_baseline: DES Karnataka & Agriculture Department: Coastal/ghats transitional canal-irrigated paddy growers in Yellapur adopting mechanized transplanters and power tillers to address labor shortages.
attribute_provenance.farmer_query_inspiration: KCC Uttara Kannada mechanization queries: Medium farmers with inherited land titles inquiring about SMAM power tiller subsidies and PM-KISAN succession transfers.
attribute_provenance.statutory_policy_test: Benchmark Design v1.0.4 Section 3.3.1 (PM-KISAN Statutory Succession vs Partition Deed Safeguard): Post-01.02.2019 land title transfer qualifies under PM-KISAN Revised Operational Guidelines Clause 3(d) because ownership was transferred through inheritance resulting from demise of parent (transfer_basis = INHERITANCE_DUE_TO_DEATH; Death Cert and mutation extract verified); strictly distinct from post-cutoff partition deeds which remain statutorily excluded; SMAM power tiller subsidy qualifies in Section A; Krishi Bhagya and Ganga Kalyana disqualified due to canal command.

intended_test_purpose: SMAM power tiller/paddy transplanter subsidy; medium holding (8.0 ac); post-2019 statutory inheritance upon demise of parent (transfer_basis=INHERITANCE_DUE_TO_DEATH, legal heir cert & mutation verified; distinct from ineligible partition deed); PM-KISAN qualifies in Section A.
